channel.title: ARLing: printable puzzles, spreadsheets and games
channel.description: New printable puzzle books, budget spreadsheets and daily puzzle games from ARLing.

item.title: Printable Kids Party Games, 2 Escape Rooms and a Detective Mystery to Print at Home
item.description: Three party games you print at home: The Pumpkin Fair Mix-Up (ages 6 to 10, 6.90 €), The Dragon Who Slept on the Key (7 to 10, 7.90 €) and The Case of the Missing Birthday Cake (8 to 12, 6.90 €). Each has a start page, a plan for grown-ups, hints and solutions, in A4 and US Letter. The pages in the picture are the first page of each game. #kidspartygames #kidsbirthdayparty #printablegames

item.title: Printable Puzzle Advent Calendar 2026, 48 Christmas Logic Puzzles for Teens and Adults
item.description: A printable Advent calendar of logic puzzles: one sheet for every day from December 1 to 24, 48 puzzles with all solutions. The front of each sheet is a Nonogram that hides a Christmas picture, the back is a second puzzle. 63 pages, A4 and US Letter PDF, 4.90 €. The pages in the picture are from the calendar. #adventcalendar #christmaspuzzles #logicpuzzles

item.title: Printable Escape Room for Kids 7 to 10, The Dragon Who Slept on the Key, Winter Party Game
item.description: Crumble the dragon has fallen asleep on the key to the toy cupboard, and only a chain of 8 puzzles leads to the music box that can wake him. Every answer opens the next envelope. Ages 7 to 10, 2 to 6 players, 30 to 60 minutes, and you do not need to know the answers. 16 pages, A4 and US Letter, 7.90 €. The page in the picture is the start page of the game. #kidsescaperoom #kidsbirthdayparty #printablegames

item.title: Halloween Logic Puzzles with Hidden Pictures, 80 Printable Puzzles for Adults and Teens
item.description: Twenty of the 80 puzzles are Nonograms that hide Halloween pictures drawn for this book: a pumpkin, a bat, a haunted house and more. The other chapters are Hashi, Kakuro and Slitherlink, each opening with the rules and the first moves explained step by step. 91 pages, A4 and US Letter PDF, all solutions at the back, 4.90 €. The page in the picture is from the book. #halloweenpuzzles #nonogram #printablepuzzles

item.title: reMarkable Planner Template, 372 Logic Puzzles, A Puzzle Linked from Every Day Page, E-ink PDF
item.description: One PDF that is a planner and a puzzle book at the same time. 372 puzzles in 10 types, one waiting on every day of an undated year, and every page of it is a link. The pages in the picture are real pages of the PDF. Sold on Etsy, instant download. #remarkable #kindlescribe #logicpuzzles

item.title: Wedding Planner Spreadsheet, Excel and Google Sheets, Wedding Budget, Guest List, RSVP Tracker
item.description: A wedding spreadsheet that keeps the money, the guests and the to do list in one file, and does the math for you. Type what things cost and when each deposit is due; see what is paid, what you still owe and what is due next. The sheets in the picture are printed straight from the sample file. Sold on Etsy, instant download. #spreadsheet #exceltemplate #budgetplanner

item.title: Small Business Bookkeeping Spreadsheet, Order and Inventory Tracker, EU UK VAT, Excel Template 2027
item.description: Bookkeeping, stock and pricing for makers and small shops, in one Excel file that does the adding up for you. The sheets in the picture are printed straight from the sample file. Sold on Etsy, instant download. #spreadsheet #exceltemplate #budgetplanner

item.title: Reseller Spreadsheet 2027, eBay Poshmark Mercari Depop Fees, Inventory and Profit Tracker
item.description: Buy, list, sell, and know what you really make on every item. One Excel file that works out the fees, the profit and what is still sitting in stock. The sheets in the picture are printed straight from the sample file. Sold on Etsy, instant download. #spreadsheet #exceltemplate #budgetplanner

item.title: Paycheck Budget Spreadsheet for Excel 2027, Bill Tracker Sorted by Due Date, Budget Template
item.description: A paycheck budget spreadsheet that answers the question every payday: which bills does this paycheck have to cover, and what is left? Type your bills once. Every payday of 2027 is worked out for you, with the bills due before the next payday, sorted by due date. The sheets in the picture are printed straight from the sample file. Sold on Etsy, instant download. #spreadsheet #exceltemplate #budgetplanner

item.title: Landlord Spreadsheet 2027, Rental Property Tracker, Rent Roll, Cash Flow and Yield per Property
item.description: Rent, costs, cash flow and who still owes you, for every property, in one Excel file that does the adding up for you. The sheets in the picture are printed straight from the sample file. Sold on Etsy, instant download. #spreadsheet #exceltemplate #budgetplanner

item.title: Couples Budget Spreadsheet for Excel 2027, Shared Expenses Tracker, Who Paid and Who Owes
item.description: A couples budget spreadsheet that keeps your money together and apart, and settles up for you. Every payment has who paid it and whether it was for both of you or for one. At the end of the month the file tells you who owes whom, and how much. The sheets in the picture are printed straight from the sample file. Sold on Etsy, instant download. #spreadsheet #exceltemplate #budgetplanner

The sheets in the picture are printed straight from the sample file. Buy it on arling.sk or on Etsy, instant download. #spreadsheet #exceltemplate #budgetplanner
